      "evidence": "Does not change mempool policy, data structures, limits, or acceptance rules; it merely monitors when a broadcast transaction enters the mempool.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Mempool data structures and policy rules are not touched by this change."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies transaction broadcast behavior within the private broadcast subsystem in BroadcastTransaction.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "unblocks",
      "rationale": "Synchronous mempool waiting resolves immediate-return issues during private broadcast and is a stated 'prerequisite for adding private broadcast support to the wallet.' It also prevents deadlock risks for callers waiting on background notifications while holding wallet locks."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies sendrawtransaction parameter handling and execution behavior to block on mempool acceptance with a timeout.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Addresses compatibility issues for third-party software calling sendrawtransaction that expects successful returns to guarantee the transaction is present in the local mempool. Allowing callers to configure or bypass the timeout fixes a subtle interface expectation."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Introduces notification hooks in CValidationInterface and broadcast logic, not general-purpose synchronization or threading utilities.",

categories.name: docs
categories.evidence: PR focuses on transaction broadcast synchronization and RPC behavior, with no standalone documentation changes.
categories.rationale: Documentation is not the primary subject of this PR.

categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Does not change mempool policy, data structures, limits, or acceptance rules; it merely monitors when a broadcast transaction enters the mempool.
categories.rationale: Mempool data structures and policy rules are not touched by this change.

categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies transaction broadcast behavior within the private broadcast subsystem in BroadcastTransaction.
categories.rationale: Synchronous mempool waiting resolves immediate-return issues during private broadcast and is a stated 'prerequisite for adding private broadcast support to the wallet.' It also prevents deadlock risks for callers waiting on background notifications while holding wallet locks.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Modifies sendrawtransaction parameter handling and execution behavior to block on mempool acceptance with a timeout.
categories.rationale: Addresses compatibility issues for third-party software calling sendrawtransaction that expects successful returns to guarantee the transaction is present in the local mempool. Allowing callers to configure or bypass the timeout fixes a subtle interface expectation.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Introduces notification hooks in CValidationInterface and broadcast logic, not general-purpose synchronization or threading utilities.
categories.rationale: General utilities and libraries are not modified.
